user.title: Set up Camera Wall
user.description: Install the Camera Wall TV app first. After setup, press Send setup to TV once to pair it.

data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL reachable from the TV

data_description.ha_url: Use your HA address on the local network, such as http://192.168.1.10:8123.
data_description.token: Use a token for a dedicated HA user. It is sent to the TV only when you press Send setup to TV.
data_description.cameras: The first four appear immediately; use Left and Right for more pages.
data_description.mode: MJPEG is recommended. If a stream fails, the app tries snapshots.

abort.already_configured: Camera Wall is already configured for this TV.
